entries.title: Cliff diagnosis done: the roads-climb-cliffs bug is WorldForge's street carver, and TileForge is missing nothing
entries.detail: Answers to sl-0028, all measured on the b70 pack, no fixes applied yet. (1) PROVENANCE: high-cliff walkability is WorldForge-side semantics, not TileForge tile properties - terrain.rock sits in the loader's BLOCKED_MATERIALS list, and the cliff terraces are adapter-side ART drawn inside the rock mass under an explicit invariant ('every walkable cell stays level 0 - a cliff can never cross traversal'). The assertion the designer remembers giving is the narrower 2026-07-28 moss ruling: bare moss carpet on LEVEL-0 apron rock walks; terraces stay solid. Measured b70 grid: plateau tops 1705 cells with only 79 walkable (every one a road/lane cell), cliff edges 231 with 29 walkable (lane crossings), apron 781 with 157 walkable (moss + graded trails), and the RAMP layer is ALL ZEROS - ramps are never placed by anything, though the package ships four walkable ramp families. The stated intent (edges unwalkable / tops walkable / ramps the access) is NOT implemented: tops are blocked and ramps do not exist. Making tops walkable is a walkability-CONTRACT change touching pack, game, and world_filler - designer-ruled arc, not a quiet fix. Related: world_filler's 'walkable cliff-top tiles' observation (sl-0026) is actually moss carpets and graded/lane cells, not tops. (2) ROADS x CLIFFS: wilderness trails GRADE rock crossings to gravel (zero violations measured), but the city street-web carvers write lanes with NO rock grading - the b70 snowline city carved 108 walkable lane cells at terrace level >= 1 (x 200-237, y 25-26): streets climbing cliff faces with no ramps. That is the designer's road issue. A second ungraded writer (the landmark approach carver) is latent. entries.detail: Designer report with screenshots from the intaken b72 overworld: city streets show bare cobble plaza and a highway shows bare wide corridor ground — no road tiles anywhere ('we do want banded roads... i want the roads in the cities to be the actual road tiles'). Also stop honoring the stale roadTypesLegacy flag anywhere it is consulted (the game's pinned package manifests still carry it; TF drops it at the next natural cut). Fix bar: the three road families render as the pack's own art, matching the WF viewer's look. DESIGNER TASTE BOUNDARY recorded tonight: big inter-city corridors staying WIDE is fine (ground layers untouched — the fix adds the road art on top, it does not neck anything); the want is city streets + small roads legible as actual road tiles; the designer taste-rules the rendered look on screen (taste legal post-shift; the pending b72 country-road-look verdict fires only after roads actually draw).
